mapper.select: SELECT *, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS order_date, plan_user_name AS plan_user_name FROM tb_purchase_parts_order WHERE id = #{orderId} AND IFNULL(is_deleted, 0) = 0

SELECT d.id, d.order_id, d.parts_number, d.is_old_order, COALESCE(NULLIF(pm.EXTERNAL_PART_NO, ''), d.parts_number) AS parts_no, COALESCE(NULLIF(pm.CHINESE_NAME, ''), d.parts_name) AS parts_name, d.need_number, d.need_date, d.supplier_order_status, d.delivery_status, o.order_no, o.address AS ship_to_address, o.take_over_connect AS take_over_connect, o.connect_number AS connect_number, d.storage_name AS storage_name, IFNULL(d.delivery_number, 0) AS shipped_qty, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(s.shipped_qty) FROM tb_srm_asn_line s WHERE s.split_line_id IN (SELECT id FROM tb_srm_po_split_line WHERE detail_id = d.id)), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.ship_qty) FROM tb_srm_asn a WHERE a.order_detail_id = d.id AND IFNULL(a.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND a.status != 'SHIPPED' AND a.ship_qty IS NOT NULL), 0) AS pending_ship_qty, IFNULL(d.need_number, 0) - CASE WHEN TRIM(IFNULL(d.delivery_status, '')) = '已交付' THEN IFNULL(d.need_number, 0) ELSE 0 END AS remaining_qty, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.ship_qty) FROM tb_srm_asn a WHERE a.order_detail_id = d.id AND IFNULL(a.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND a.ship_qty IS NOT NULL), 0) AS created_asn_qty FROM tb_purchase_parts_order_detail d INNER JOIN tb_purchase_parts_order o ON d.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN tb_parts_maint pm ON d.parts_number = pm.PARTS_NO AND pm.IS_DELETED = 0 WHERE d.order_id = #{orderId} AND IFNULL(d.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(o.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ORDER BY d.id ASC

SELECT d.id AS order_detail_id, d.order_id, d.id AS order_line_no, COALESCE(NULLIF(pm.EXTERNAL_PART_NO, ''), d.parts_number) AS parts_no, COALESCE(NULLIF(pm.CHINESE_NAME, ''), d.parts_name) AS parts_name, d.need_number AS order_qty, d.need_number AS confirmed_qty, 0 AS shipped_qty, d.need_number - 0 AS remaining_qty, d.need_date, o.supplier_id, o.storage_name AS ship_to_plant, o.address AS ship_to_address FROM tb_purchase_parts_order_detail d INNER JOIN tb_purchase_parts_order o ON d.order_id = o.id left JOIN tb_parts_maint pm ON d.parts_number = pm.PARTS_NO AND pm.IS_DELETED = 0 WHERE d.id = #{orderDetailId} AND IFNULL(d.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(o.is_deleted, 0) = 0

SELECT d.id AS order_detail_id, d.order_id, d.parts_number, COALESCE(NULLIF(pm.EXTERNAL_PART_NO, ''), d.parts_number) AS parts_no, COALESCE(NULLIF(pm.CHINESE_NAME, ''), d.parts_name) AS parts_name, d.need_number, d.need_date, d.supplier_order_status, o.order_no, o.address AS ship_to_address, o.take_over_connect AS take_over_connect, o.connect_number AS connect_number, d.storage_name AS storage_name, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(s.shipped_qty) FROM tb_srm_asn_line s WHERE s.split_line_id IN (SELECT id FROM tb_srm_po_split_line WHERE detail_id = d.id)), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.ship_qty) FROM tb_srm_asn a WHERE a.order_detail_id = d.id AND IFNULL(a.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND a.ship_qty IS NOT NULL), 0) AS shipped_qty, d.need_number - ( COALESCE((SELECT SUM(s.shipped_qty) FROM tb_srm_asn_line s WHERE s.split_line_id IN (SELECT id FROM tb_srm_po_split_line WHERE detail_id = d.id)), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.ship_qty) FROM tb_srm_asn a WHERE a.order_detail_id = d.id AND IFNULL(a.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND a.ship_qty IS NOT NULL), 0) ) AS remaining_qty, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.ship_qty) FROM tb_srm_asn a WHERE a.order_detail_id = d.id AND IFNULL(a.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND a.ship_qty IS NOT NULL), 0) AS created_asn_qty, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.ship_qty) FROM tb_srm_asn a WHERE a.order_detail_id = d.id AND IFNULL(a.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND a.status = 'SHIPPED' AND a.ship_qty IS NOT NULL), 0) AS expected_receipt_qty FROM tb_purchase_parts_order_detail d INNER JOIN tb_purchase_parts_order o ON d.order_id = o.id left JOIN tb_parts_maint pm ON d.parts_number = pm.PARTS_NO AND pm.IS_DELETED = 0 WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo} AND IFNULL(d.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(o.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ORDER BY d.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_purchase_parts_order_detail SET supplier_order_status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND IFNULL(is_deleted, 0) = 0
UPDATE tb_purchase_parts_order_detail SET supplier_order_status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderDetailId} AND IFNULL(is_deleted, 0) = 0
UPDATE tb_purchase_parts_order SET supplier_order_status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND IFNULL(is_deleted, 0) = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ship_qty), 0) FROM tb_srm_asn WHERE order_detail_id = #{orderDetailId} and IFNULL(is_deleted, 0) = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_purchase_parts_order_detail d INNER JOIN tb_purchase_parts_order o ON d.order_id = o.id WHERE IFNULL(d.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(o.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND d.supplier_order_status != 0 AND TRIM(IFNULL(d.delivery_status, '')) != '已交付'
AND o.supplier_id = #{supplierId}
AND o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{orderNo}, '%')
AND (
d.parts_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{pn}, '%')
)
AND o.create_time >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND o.create_time <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(d.parts_number, '-', DATE_FORMAT(o.need_date, '%Y-%m'))) FROM tb_purchase_parts_order_detail d INNER JOIN tb_purchase_parts_order o ON d.order_id = o.id WHERE o.supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND IFNULL(d.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(o.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND o.need_date >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 12 MONTH)
AND d.parts_number IN
#{pn}
AND o.need_date >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, '-01')
AND o.need_date < DATE_ADD(CONCAT(#{endDate}, '-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_purchase_parts_order_detail d INNER JOIN tb_purchase_parts_order o ON d.order_id = o.id WHERE o.supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND IFNULL(d.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(o.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND o.order_type = 'JIT'
AND o.order_no IN
#{no}
AND d.parts_number IN
#{pn}
AND o.create_time >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND o.create_time <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')

SELECT d.parts_number AS parts_number, d.parts_name AS parts_name, o.storage_name AS demand_factory,
DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y-%m') AS time_period
DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y') AS time_period
DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y-%m') AS time_period
, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count, SUM(d.need_number) AS total_qty FROM tb_purchase_parts_order_detail d INNER JOIN tb_purchase_parts_order o ON d.order_id = o.id WHERE IFNULL(d.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(o.is_deleted, 0) = 0
AND o.supplier_id = #{supplierId}
AND o.create_time >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND o.create_time <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
AND o.storage_name IN
#{factory}
AND d.parts_number IN
#{pn}
GROUP BY d.parts_number, d.parts_name, o.storage_name,
DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y-%m')
DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y')
DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY d.parts_number, time_period

mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(need_number), 0) FROM tb_purchase_parts_order_detail WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND IFNULL(is_deleted, 0) = 0

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.ship_qty) FROM tb_srm_asn a INNER JOIN tb_srm_asn_order ao ON a.id = ao.asn_id WHERE ao.order_id = #{orderId} AND IFNULL(a.is_deleted, 0) = 0), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(al.shipped_qty) FROM tb_srm_asn_line al INNER JOIN tb_srm_po_split_line sl ON al.split_line_id = sl.id INNER JOIN tb_purchase_parts_order_detail d ON sl.detail_id = d.id WHERE d.order_id = #{orderId}), 0)

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(pm.EXTERNAL_PART_NO, ''), pm.PARTS_NO) AS parts_number, COALESCE(NULLIF(pm.CHINESE_NAME, ''), pm.PARTS_NAME) AS parts_name, o.storage_name AS demand_factory,
DATE_FORMAT(d.need_date, '%Y-%m')
DATE_FORMAT(d.need_date, '%Y')
DATE_FORMAT(d.need_date, '%Y-%m')
AS time_key, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count, SUM(d.need_number) AS total_qty FROM tb_purchase_parts_order_detail d INNER JOIN tb_purchase_parts_order o ON d.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN tb_parts_maint pm ON d.parts_number = pm.PARTS_NO AND pm.IS_DELETED = 0 WHERE IFNULL(d.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(o.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND o.supplier_order_status != 0
AND o.supplier_id = #{supplierId}
AND d.need_date >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, '-01')
AND d.need_date <= LAST_DAY(CONCAT(#{endDate}, '-01'))
AND o.storage_name IN
#{factory}
AND d.parts_number IN
#{pn}
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(pm.EXTERNAL_PART_NO, ''), d.parts_number), COALESCE(NULLIF(pm.CHINESE_NAME, ''), d.parts_name), o.storage_name,
DATE_FORMAT(d.need_date, '%Y-%m')
DATE_FORMAT(d.need_date, '%Y')
DATE_FORMAT(d.need_date, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY pm.EXTERNAL_PART_NO, time_key
